journey.title: Let somebody else reach an agent safely
journey.purpose: The owner gives another person access to an agent and can see, before confirming, exactly what that person will be able to make the agent do — including the effect on every room they share.

steps.intent: Finds the person, who is currently a stranger by default.
Reads what the proposed tier will permit, in plain language.
Sees which group ceilings the change will move.
Watches the agent refuse a request that exceeds the new tier, and state what it withheld.

claims.statement: The permission effect and the group-ceiling effect are both stated before the change is confirmed.
No path through this journey can grant an owner-only capability to a tier below owner.
claims.rationale: OT-P0-011 requires this by construction, so the journey must not contain a path that appears to offer it.
